custom_commands:
set -e
# pt_BR.UTF-8 além do en_US (data por extenso no hyprlock)
sed -i 's/^#\(pt_BR\.UTF-8 UTF-8\)/\1/' /etc/locale.gen
locale-gen
# Clona os dotfiles na home do usuário criado no menu (UID 1000)
user="$(getent passwd 1000 | cut -d: -f1)"
if [ -n "$user" ] && [ ! -e "/home/$user/dotenvs" ]; then
  runuser -u "$user" -- git clone https://github.com/RWallan/dotenvs.git "/home/$user/dotenvs"
fi
